description: Koordinates is a data resource listed in Free GIS Data (rtwilson), a curated list of free geographic datasets under the section "General", published or maintained by the publisher of koordinates.com. GIS data aggregation site including data in a number of categories such as elevation, environment, climate etc. Some global datasets, some based on continents, some for specific countries. Mostly vector, but some raster. Registration required. Coverage: worldwide or as described in the list entry. The list files it under "General" with the note that registration is required. The entry links to koordinates.com. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge but needs registration according to the listing; the conditions were not read. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure mapping and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-free-gis-data-list.
